title: Chapter 6: The Battle Of Insects (Part 2)
content:
Chapter 6: The Battle Of Insects (Part 2)

The battlefield situation reversed!

The strange crying outside the Zerg territory suddenly turned into a vicious curse whisper.

Wu Qing listened attentively and felt dizzy. He was so scared that he immediately calmed down and kept his mind.

This was the aftermath of the mental pollution under the protection of the Zerg collective consciousness. If he was directly faced with the attack of that strange existence, with his current strength, he would probably go crazy in an instant.

Feeling the strange and powerful mental power, Wu Qing stopped the hatching of a wave of puppies and added 3 hosts to strengthen the mental power of the Zerg collective consciousness.

At this moment, a group of black creatures like bats suddenly flew over the Zerg territory and rushed towards the host hovering in the air.

Five anti-aircraft towers distributed in different locations in the territory opened fire at the same time, breaking up this dense group of terrifying creatures.

The Zerg collective consciousness burst out a powerful mental force impact through the host. The flying unknown creatures fell on the Zerg territory like rain, and a group of puppies pounced on them and tore them apart in an instant.

In terms of energy and mental power control, the Zerg cannot compare with the Protoss, but they can still do the most basic force to overwhelm others.

This is the real world, not a game. Any method that conforms to the rules of this world can be used, and it is not restricted by the original game settings.

Who says that docile hosts cannot attack?

Sporadic flying creatures fled in a panic, and the unknown and strange aerial attempts did not work, so they died down.

On the front battlefield, the puppies were constantly consumed and replenished, and the number gradually remained at around 100.

The attacking strange creatures, from the initial tsunami-like offensive, slowly became like the receding sea water, retreating step by step.

Their number is not enough, and they can no longer support their fierce offensive.

Wu Qing stabilized the situation, and then increased the number of hosts to 10, enhancing the collective consciousness of the Zerg while increasing the population limit.

Through this offensive and defensive battle, the system has accumulated gas resources again. Wu Qing began to use three mother nests to hatch puppies and two mother nests to hatch hydralisks.

The 10 Hydralisks played an important role in the battle. They have been in emergency maneuvers in the rear to support the battle in the front.

Wu Qing began to increase the number of Hydralisks at this time. The overall situation of this battle has been determined.

Wu Qing also upgraded the long-range attack and spine enhancement through the evolution chamber and Hydralisks cave respectively. The upgrade of long-range attack enhanced the attack ability of defensive spikes and Hydralisks, and the upgrade of spine enhancement increased the attack range of Hydralisks.

The two upgrades have once again improved the strength of the Zerg territory.

As the puppies and upgraded Hydralisks continue to join the battle, the strange creatures attacking the Zerg territory were quickly wiped out without leaving a trace.

All the injured puppies burrowed into the ground to recover from their injuries.

The damaged buildings will also slowly recover automatically.

Without the enemy, there is no way to quickly obtain a large amount of resources. The existing resources need Wu Qing to plan.

Wu Qing first looked at the conditions for upgrading or star-raising the mother nest, and found that it was not that simple.

If the hive can be upgraded to the second stage with only the resources in the game, and high-level buildings and soldiers can be produced, it would be too easy.

Sure enough, in reality, this is not possible.

If the hive wants to be upgraded to the second stage, it must have a three-star hive and other buildings.

And if the hive wants to be upgraded to one star, it is not only to spend resources, but also a prerequisite, that is, it must absorb the luck of ten creatures with strength reaching level one.

Whether it is killing or conquering, it needs ten.

Wu Qing has not encountered a level one creature yet, how to kill and conquer?

Of course, the terrifying weirdness lingering outside the territory does not count.

Since there is no hope of upgrading, we can only make plans on the existing soldiers.

Wu Qing first increased the number of hosts to 15, which is both a trump card guarantee and a population limit guarantee, and is given priority.

15 hosts hovered above the Zerg territory, and it felt like they covered most of the sky.

Wu Qing replenished 20 more worker bees, which is a stable energy source in normal times and a guarantee for rapid construction of buildings in emergency situations.

20 worker bees running back and forth to transport resources is just right. With the current area of the territory, if there are more worker bees, it is easy for the worker bees to collide on the road, affecting efficiency.

Some things are not the more the better, just the right amount is the best.

When the strength is sufficient, the territory is expanded, and the sub-base is built, the worker bees can continue to increase.

For the remaining resources, Wu Qing must first ensure that the number of hydralisks reaches 30, and if there are extra resources, then produce puppies.

No matter how many resources there are, they are just numbers. Spending them is strength.

Moreover, the more various units the Zerg has, the stronger the collective consciousness of the Zerg will be.

The vicious curse whispers outside the Zerg territory turned into low cries again. When Wu Qing thought it would be quiet for a while, the host detected a large number of creatures approaching the territory under the ground outside the Zerg territory.

"The ground, the sky, and the underground, it's time to play!"

Wu Qing cheered up again.

The enemies sent to him are all resources!

Tomorrow morning, there will be a large number of green-skinned people outside the forest who will come to trouble him, and he must be fully prepared.

The unknown creatures underground sneaked all the way and entered the Zerg territory.

The places covered by the Zerg organic spread are all Zerg territories. Once you enter the Zerg territory, you will not escape the eyes of the Zerg collective consciousness.

When the Zerg collective consciousness checked, they saw a bunch of strange-looking bugs. These bugs were living creatures, not those weird things that attacked the territory from the ground.

What kind of operation was it to come to the Zerg territory to play with bugs? Even Wu Qing was a little confused.

At this time, the expert host who controlled the bugs came over and operated on the mental level. All the bugs that entered the Zerg territory crawled out of the ground obediently.

This was because the organic spread took the initiative to make way for them, otherwise these bugs would not be able to climb up.

When Wu Qing saw these bugs, he immediately lost interest. A bunch of puppies pounced on them and killed all these completely defenseless bugs, turning them into system resources.

After sending a wave of bug benefits, the weird existence outside the Zerg territory no longer had any ideas about the Zerg territory on the physical level.

But he laughed, cried, cursed viciously, and even made a seductive moan, trying to pollute Wu Qing, a special existence, from the spiritual level.

Unfortunately, Wu Qing was once the master of the world, and now he is protected by the collective consciousness of the Zerg. These tricks of his are fine for other people, but they are too shallow to deal with him.

The energetic unknown weirdness just fought with Wu Qing.

Wu Qing lay on the bed, enjoying the comfortable massage of energy, which kept his physical condition and mental strength in the best condition at all times.

A sleepless night.
